title: Repair mixed-state Main Display card allocation and prove the equal bottom band physically
verify: Before any production write, capture fresh task-scoped RED from the current W32-dependent baseline: deterministic host mixed-state render at 2460x1080 and 1280x720 with Yesterday empty and today/tomorrow/day_after populated, plus a fresh physical baseline on the unlocked TECNO LI6 serial 1156725456009666 after an operator-authorized baseline build/install. Record the actual View/card bounds; do not reuse W32 or W31 RED/GREEN evidence.

Correct only the shared Main Display View allocation in DisplayCapability.kt and its focused host support in DisplayProjectionTest.kt so the empty/populated mixed state uses one common weather-band allocation: all four cards have equal height and common bottom alignment, Yesterday is never taller, the band remains 25-30% and the clock zone 70-75%, and city/date, maximum-fit HH:mm and timer controls remain in their accepted regions.

Add a deterministic host regression for the exact mixed fixture (Yesterday empty, today/tomorrow/day_after populated) and assert the resulting four-card geometry and state/order. Add an allocation-level assertion or receipt over the real View tree when the project-native test harness exposes it without widening the hard boundary; if it is not feasible, record the concrete harness limitation and retain the mixed-state regression without inventing a second mechanism.

Obtain claim-equivalent GREEN from the same host fixture and fresh physical route. On the unlocked TECNO LI6 serial 1156725456009666, after the built APK is installed under the existing operator authorization, capture a fresh screenshot of the mixed state and measured card bounds proving the empty Yesterday shell is the same bottom-aligned band height as the three populated cards. Emulator, AVD and QEMU are forbidden.

Run all five project-native gates and the existing Main Display visual-QA/boundary review. Preserve Weather Context/provider/normalization/cache/history/freshness ownership, Timer & Alert countdown/cancellation/overdue/audio ownership, runtime/fullscreen/timer behavior and no-data shell semantics; do not synthesize weather values.

Planner does not install or upload an APK. Execution may install only under the already-granted operator authorization; stop immediately on any emulator request, unauthorized device action, provider/weather change, timer/runtime ownership change, or write outside the exact two-file boundary.
